arStrings.szText: {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} {c_important}Summon{/c} Skill and summons an Abyssal Pit for {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds that consumes Non-Elite enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:PIT_DMG}{/c} damage, Knocking them down, and hiding them in {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c}. Recast to Pull additional targets into the Pit. {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} now costs {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} Dominance.
{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} repeatedly reaches for you and Pulls away enemies for {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage against {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} enemies.
Casting {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} commands your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to Slow enemies by {c_number}[{SF_25}|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{SF_28}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp's{/c} area is increased by {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|%|]{/c} and Pulls in {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} becomes a direct grasp attack that transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} and Pulls enemies inward.
